name: P-MMEval
l2: 并行多语言多任务评测
intro: P-MMEval 是通义实验室构建的平行多语言多任务基准。它以三组不同规模模型对和配对样本 t 检验筛选基础数据集，再加入五个专项数据集，通过 GPT-4o 补齐缺失翻译并由专业翻译团队复核，最终以八个基准组成部分、七类任务和十种语言评估多语言能力与跨语言迁移一致性。
build_method: 模型规模显著性筛选, GPT-4o补译, 专业翻译复核与本地化
language: 英文, 中文, 阿拉伯文, 西班牙文, 日文, 韩文, 泰文, 法文, 葡萄牙文, 越南文
task_type: 多语言理解与生成, 数学与逻辑推理, 代码生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 十语言平行样本, 英文/母语/英文少样本提示, 跨语言迁移一致性
scale: 8个基准组成部分, 7类任务, 10种语言, 共21,580条分语言实例
task_type_en: Multilingual understanding and generation, Math and logical reasoning, Code generation, Instruction following
build_method_en: Model-scale Significance Screening, GPT-4o Translation Completion, Professional Translation Review and Localization
eval_feature_en: Parallel Samples in Ten Languages, English/Native/English Few-shot Prompts, Cross-lingual Transfer Consistency
intro_en: P-MMEval is a parallel multilingual multitask benchmark from Tongyi Lab. It screens fundamental datasets using three model-size pairs and paired-sample t-tests, adds five specialized datasets, fills missing translations with GPT-4o, and has professional translators review them. The final suite evaluates multilingual capability and transfer consistency across eight benchmark components, seven task types, and ten languages.
language_en: English, Chinese, Arabic, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Thai, French, Portuguese, Vietnamese
scale_en: 8 benchmark components, 7 task types, 10 languages, 21,580 language-specific instances
default_l2: 并行多语言多任务评测
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.09116 Sections 3-4, Tables 1-3, and the official Qwen/P-MMEval dataset card. The diagrams follow the paper's ten languages from seven families; eleven-dataset candidate pool; three model-size pairs; English-plus-four-language, at-most-250-instance paired-sample t-tests with p below 0.01 for every pair; retained XNLI, MHellaSwag, and Flores-200; five specialized additions; GPT-4o translation completion followed by professional review, correction, localization, and removal; exact per-language component counts; eight benchmark components spanning seven tasks; English, native, and English few-shot prompts; MGSM chain-of-thought versus direct answering elsewhere; Accuracy, BLEU, Pass@1, and CACR reporting.
